blocks.text: The light was not supposed to be on.

blocks.alt: A rotting jetty vanishing into fog, a lit window beyond it.

blocks.text: The dock is empty. Fog hides the base of the lighthouse, but its lamp is lit — and it hasn't worked in eleven years.

choices.text: Walk the dock toward the light
Check the tide pools for the old lantern

blocks.text: Under a shelf of rock, wedged in the weed: a lantern, glass intact.

choices.text: Take it and head for the door

blocks.text: The door is shut. You have *{trust}* reasons to knock instead of trying the latch.

choices.text: Force the latch with the lantern's edge
choices.lockedText: You have nothing stiff enough to force it.

blocks.text: Footsteps. The door opens on its own weight before anyone answers.

choices.text: Go up to the lamp room

blocks.text: The latch gives with a crack that echoes off the water. Whatever was inside heard that too.

choices.text: Go up to the lamp room anyway

blocks.text: The lamp is burning on its own, no keeper in sight — and for the first time in eleven years, it isn't alone.
The lamp goes dark the moment you reach the top of the stairs.
